title: Every bounded known profile in the fixed orbit class is leading-coefficient rigid

rigidity.coercive_margin: K1661/K1663 and the K1664 small-/large-g comparison give C_(F,N)+gD_(M,N)>=eta^2 m_g N B_N for B_N=sum rho_k^2 and fixed m_g>0.
rigidity.full_gap: K1637 and K1672 give Q_N-lambda_N^statG>=eta^2 m_g N B_N-CN log N>=-CN log N.
rigidity.coefficient: The normalized liminf of the full gap by N^4 is nonnegative for every bounded known nonnegative profile in the declared orbit class.
rigidity.positive_regimes: If B_N/log N tends to infinity the bound is eventually positive; if B_N>=bN^3 it is positive Theta(N^4).
rigidity.scope_guard: Profiles with B_N=O(log N) are coefficient-rigid but need not have a proved positive gap; unknown profiles, growing latent dimension, non-orbit laws and the unrestricted ground coefficient remain open.
